neighbours.label: the particle after 'phase' in 'phase out' / 'phase in' (gradual removal or introduction), as against 'out'/'in' after other verbs and 'phase' as a noun
fire: The utility will gradually phase out its oldest gas turbines.
Europe agreed on a phase-out of combustion engine sales.
The school plans to phase in the new curriculum next autumn.
Many airlines are phasing out their four-engine jets.
Regulators want to phase out leaded fuel for small planes.
The bank decided to phase in higher fees over two years.
Our town is phasing out plastic straws in restaurants.
Parliament approved a plan to phase out coal mining by 2035.
quiet: The utility will gradually shut down its oldest gas turbines.
Europe agreed on a ban of combustion engine sales.
The school plans to roll out the new curriculum next autumn.
Many airlines are selling off their four-engine jets.
Regulators want to rule out leaded fuel for small planes.
The bank decided to bring in higher fees over two years.
Our town is in the final phase of banning plastic straws.
Parliament approved a plan to wind down coal mining by 2035.
